title: Origami-based tunable truss structures for non-volatile mechanical memory operation

E_GEOM.locator: Main Results Geometry, Fig. 1; SI Fig. 1 and Notes 1–2, printed pp. 13–15
E_GEOM.facts: Four initial geometries, R=90 mm, correction angle 9.7 degrees; split-joint physical model uses modified radius R-prime; pentagonal example

E_BUILD.locator: Main Methods Prototype fabrication and compression test
E_BUILD.facts: Laser-cut acrylic polygons, 3D-printed PLA universal joints, 3.18 mm stainless shafts; spring constants 3.32 kN/m except bifurcation 1.08 kN/m

E_COMP.locator: Main Fig. 2; SI Fig. 2, Note 3, printed pp. 15–17
E_COMP.facts: Horizontal fixed-right/free-left rotation rig, BiSlider Velmex, Kyowa LUX-B-50N-ID; force/displacement measurements and numerical integration; mean/SD plotted without trial count

E_STIFF.facts: Linear fit window u/h0=0.01–0.03 avoids initial static friction; comparative normalized slopes

E_LUBE.facts: Grease applied to joints reportedly improved early compression data; product, amount, sites and matched experiment plan not specified

E_BIF.locator: Main Fig. 2d; SI Fig. 4, Note 5, printed pp. 18–19
E_BIF.facts: 119 mm/0 degree prototype; two guide shafts/linear bearings constrain rotation; comparison to unconstrained setup

E_ONE.locator: Main Fig. 3 and one-bit Results; SI Figs. 6–7, Note 7, printed pp. 20–21
E_ONE.facts: Opposite-chirality 90 mm cells share polygon; 45 mm precompression; crank force and OFV-505 displacement converted to torque/angle; measured forward 0 to 1

E_READ.locator: Main two-bit Results; SI Fig. 9 and Note 9, printed pp. 22–23
E_READ.facts: Main describes two laser vibrometers for angle readout; SI emphasizes stage/crank phi1 and LDV phi3; channel mapping remains required

E_TWO.locator: Main Figs. 4–5; SI Figs. 9–10, Note 9, printed pp. 22–24
E_TWO.facts: Four 90 mm cells, +46/-46/+46/-46 degrees; pair precompressions 50 and 47.5 mm; two trapezoid-segment programs

E_0011.locator: Main Fig. 5a–b; SI Fig. 10a–b, Note 9 printed p. 23
E_0011.facts: 00 to 10 to 11 by first-bit input only; reported phi1 about -62 to +62 degrees

E_0110.locator: Main Fig. 5c–d; SI Fig. 10c–d, Note 9 printed pp. 23–24
E_0110.facts: Preparation directly drives second bit with first input unconstrained; 01 to 11 to 10 under increasing-then-decreasing first-bit input; T/2 has no numerical duration

E_MOV1.locator: SI description sheet Movie 1; inspected sampled frames of official Movie 1
E_MOV1.facts: Bistable paper/truss comparison; manual folding/unfolding and paper facet distortion; paper material/net/dimensions absent

E_MOV5.locator: SI description sheet Movie 5 and Note 7; inspected sampled frames of official Movie 5
E_MOV5.facts: Manual one-bit demonstration; sampled frames include labeled Bit=1 and Bit=0 with hand interaction; no torque/time trace inferred

E_MODEL.locator: Main Methods; SI Notes 1–2,4,6 and Fig. 5
E_MODEL.facts: Energy model, modified geometry, ideal zero-stiffness proof and numerical geometry/stability map

E_PROPOSED_READ.locator: SI Fig. 8, Note 8 printed pp. 21–22; Main two-bit Results
E_PROPOSED_READ.facts: Angular perturbation torque curves are numerical; frequency readout proposed; no measured perturbation/frequency experiment

E_EXTEND.locator: Main Discussion; SI Figs. 11–12 and Note 10 printed pp. 24–25
E_EXTEND.facts: Planar spring-linked bits, controllable clutches, six-bit example and graded serial architecture are conceptual extensions

E_DATA.facts: Supporting data available from corresponding author on request; no raw dataset obtained

sources.scope: Results, Methods, figure captions, Discussion, supplementary links

sources.page_offset: PDF page = printed page + 1; description sheet first; printed page 12 has no visible page number
